thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SmartRoute anomaly detected — eu-west: 30m spike in tail latency (p95 -> 1.4s). Economy tier error rate + throttles increased by 4x. Auto-mitigation suggested: reduce economy weight and enable regional quota. Paging on-call.
ashok: on it. joining from phone. any impact to paid customers?
leah: seeing elevated 500s from Economy in the dashboard. Dedicated and Hosted tiers look fine. Customer-facing latency complaints from region eu-west started ~23:10 UTC.
maria: adding quick metrics: traffic delta +85% in economy lane, prefix-cache hit ratio unchanged. KV cache pressure not the cause.
ben: flagging recent routing policy change — we promoted adaptive-tranche for eu-west at 22:50 UTC. Could be related.
ashok: copy. priority: 1) stop customer impact 2) keep throughput for premium 3) investigate rollout. Immediate mitigations proposed:
- lower economy weight to 10% in eu-west
- enable per-customer quota caps for economy
- temporarily disable adaptive-tranche steer for eu-west
- if needed, route economy -> economy-economy (cold) pool with rate limit
leah: agree. low-risk first: lower weight + enable quota. who can run the router command?
ben: I can push the router change. command below; will dry-run then apply.
ben: ```
# dry-run
rictl smartroute adjust --region eu-west --policy adaptive-tranche --tier economy --set-weight 0.10 --dry-run
# apply
rictl smartroute adjust --region eu-west --policy adaptive-tranche --tier economy --set-weight 0.10
``` 
maria: I'll flip per-customer quotas via ops API after weight change. sample:
maria: ```
POST /ops/v1/quotas/region/eu-west
{
  "tier": "economy",
  "max_requests_per_minute": 120,
  "apply_immediately": true
}
```
ashok: @ben please apply weight change, announce when done. I'll coordinate quota toggle and keep customers informed.
ben: applying now (will post logs). :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ben: applied weight change — commit id: rtr-7f3a. Observability: economy traffic down ~72% within 30s.
sre-bot: automated check: pv-latency-eu-west.p95 decreased from 1.4s -> 0.45s after routing update.
leah: nice. errors also falling. still seeing small tail for a subset of customer IDs (shard 11).
maria: quota toggle running now.
maria: quota apply success, patch id q-88b. Throttles for heavy customers now enforced.
ashok: good. next step: keep adaptive-tranche disabled for 30m and monitor. Ben, can you revert the promotion we did earlier? or at least pin policy to previous stable.
ben: pinning to stable policy version v2026-04-05. command:
ben: ```
rictl smartroute pin --region eu-west --policy adaptive-tranche --version v2026-04-05
``` 
ben: pinned.
leah: ops/alerts: creating short incident note for CS to send customer updates. @maria can you add suggested status blurb?
maria: draft blurb: "We experienced a traffic routing issue affecting Economy-tier latency in eu-west. Mitigations applied; premium customers unaffected. We continue monitoring and will follow up with root cause." share in #status-updates after you approve.
ashok: marking impact: "Partial degradation for Economy tier in eu-west — increased latency and transient errors. No data loss. No broader regions affected." severity P2.
leah: done. CS notified.
ben: quick heads-up — runtime team, can you look at KV pressure on shard 11? seeing anomalies only there.
runtime-oncall (not in thread): acknowledged, digging in the logs now.
ben: small rollback of a canary config for kernel selection was detected for shard 11 at 22:52 — possible contributor.
maria: collecting evals. please snapshot prompts and traces for affected customers for 20:50-23:20 UTC.
ashok: monitoring for 20 minutes. if metrics stable, we'll close mitigation and schedule postmortem with the rollout owner.
ben: metrics stable at 5m, p95 at 0.42s, error rate normalized.
leah: re-enabled adaptive-tranche in dry-run mode only (no promotion) so we can test safely.
leah: ```
rictl smartroute adjust --region eu-west --policy adaptive-tranche --tier economy --dry-run-enable
```
ashok: good. keep pinned to stable until postmortem.
maria: creating incident ticket INC-2026-411 with attached traces.
ashok: thanks team. summary for the timeline: 22:50 rollout -> 23:10 spike -> 23:14 mitigations triggered (weight down + quotas) -> 23:18 p95 recovered -> 23:27 pinned and follow-up actions logged. I'll hand this to on-call for next shift for RCA.
leah: closing on-call thread; will do a quick sync with Runtime & Routing tomorrow. great work. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-411 created and linked to this thread. Playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/smart-routing-triage
ashok: leaving a short blameless note — looks like interplay between a kernel-selection canary and adaptive-tranche policy. we'll include that in RCA.
leah: ping @runtime team to add logs from shard 11 to the incident ticket.
ben: added traces to INC-2026-411. marking this thread resolved for paging but keeping incident open for RCA.
leah: resolved for paging :white_check_mark: — monitoring continues.
